other_conditions: Applicant must be a superannuated teacher or scientist with at least 5 years of teaching/training experience.
Applicant must be retiring within the next 12 months (or have one year of service left).
Preference is given to candidates who retire within one year from the date of notification.
Maximum age for applying is 65 years; the appointment can continue only up to age 70 or for three years, whichever is earlier.
Application must be submitted online through the RLBS portal using the prescribed format; no other modes are accepted.
Applicants must not hold any other regular or part‑time remunerative job during the tenure and must not receive assistance for the same work from any other source.
The applicant must submit the prescribed proforma to the Deputy Director General (Education), ICAR.
benefits_summary: Honorarium of Rs. 50,000 per month plus a non‑lapsable contingency grant of Rs. 1,00,000 per year for travel, stationery, books, and other expenses, together with faculty privileges such as medical facilities.
documents_required: NOC form (if the applicant is currently in service)
Signed print‑out PDF of the application
